body:
PR Summary by Qodo

Add due dates and overdue filtering to the todo CLI ✨ Enhancement 🧪 Tests 🕐 20-40 Minutes
AI Description

>
>• Store and display strictly validated due dates on todo items.
>• List only open items due before an injectable today date.
>• Reject invalid dates without changing the file, with tests covering parsing and persistence.
>
Diagram

```mermaid graph TD Add["Add options"] --> Check{"Valid ISO date?"} -->|yes| Store["Validated store"] --> List["List command"] --> Filter["Apply list flags"] --> Output["Formatted items"] Check -->|no| Error["Bad date error"] ```
High-Level Assessment

>Keep date validation shared through the store module: it gives CLI input and stored data the same strict rules without introducing another dependency. Injecting today at the CLI boundary makes overdue behavior testable without changing the persistence model.
Files changed (7) +368 / -7

Enhancement (2) +85 / -6
cli.pyAdd due-date input and overdue listing +68/-6
>Add due-date input and overdue listing > >
>• Adds --due to add and --overdue to list, displays stored due dates, and accepts an injectable today date. Normalizes dash-led due values before argument parsing so invalid dates receive the intended error without writing the file.
>
> >todo/cli.py
store.pyValidate optional due dates in stored items +17/-0
>Validate optional due dates in stored items > >
>• Adds strict YYYY-MM-DD calendar-date validation and applies it to the optional due field when loading items. Existing save behavior preserves the field.
>
> >todo/store.py
Tests (2) +230 / -1
test_cli.pyCover due-date and overdue CLI behavior +197/-1
>Cover due-date and overdue CLI behavior > >
>• Adds tests for storing and displaying due dates, invalid-date errors without file changes, and overdue filtering against an injected today date. Also covers dash-led values, option boundaries, and interactions with existing commands.
>
> >tests/test_cli.py
test_store.pyTest due-date validation and persistence +33/-0
>Test due-date validation and persistence > >
>• Verifies valid due dates survive load and save, while non-ISO or impossible stored dates raise StoreError.
>
> >tests/test_store.py
Documentation (3) +53 / -0
DISPOSITIONS.mdRecord the disposition of the dash-led date finding +3/-0
>Record the disposition of the dash-led date finding > >
>• Documents the review finding, its fix, and the regression-test evidence.
>
> >reviews/cold/M3/DISPOSITIONS.md
round-1.mdDocument the first cold-review findings +22/-0
>Document the first cold-review findings > >
>• Records the original dash-led date error and evidence for the mission criteria.
>
> >reviews/cold/M3/round-1.md
round-2.mdDocument the follow-up cold review +28/-0
>Document the follow-up cold review > >
>• Records a review with no new findings and verifies the earlier fix and test coverage.

### The AI Code Review Platform

## Get Started
Simply sign into Github and click the "Configure" button. Check out our documentation for more info: https://docs.qodo.ai/get-started.

## Overview
Qodo automatically reviews every GitHub pull request, identifies logic bugs, edge cases, security issues, and code quality problems, and provides actionable suggestions your team can apply immediately.

Install in minutes. Integrates seamlessly into your existing workflows.

## Qodo is designed for developers who:
- Handle frequent pull requests and need reliable review coverage
- Balance code quality with fast delivery
- Work in complex, multi-repo systems
- Use AI-generated code and need stronger guardrails
- Build production software where reliability matters

## Qodo Capabilities
- ## Automated PR Analysis
  - Reviews every pull request automatically
  - No manual trigger required

- ## Context-Aware Code Review
  - Understands cross-file changes
  - Detects architectural inconsistencies

- ## Actionable Suggestions
  - Concrete code fixes
  - Clear explanations
  - Prioritized feedback

- ## Security & Reliability Checks
  - Identifies risky patterns
  - Reduces attack surface area
